claims.answer: Multiple provider lanes include Claude Code SDK/CLI, Codex SDK/app-server/ACP, Cursor Agent, Grok Build and OpenCode; the README labels OpenCode and Copilot alpha. Models alone do not establish Gemini CLI. Nimbalyst v0.83.0 calls the Antigravity language server's stateless GetModelResponse RPC and implements its own conversation and tool-call loop. This is a model transport, not an Antigravity CLI or ACP agent session. Bounded inspection found no shipped Gemini CLI, Pi or Aider provider; custom extension implementations are a separate scope.
